correctness.rationale: Assign distinct powers-of-two weights to every factor-basis vector, so all coordinate tensor weights differ and the ambient dual C*-fixed locus is exactly its M coordinate points. Each coordinate product functional vanishes on the Segre tangent space at a point whose first two factors lie in its respective kernels. Thus all M fixed points lie on the invariant dual, with none other. For possibly singular projective varieties, compact-supported Euler characteristic localizes to C*-fixed loci; projectivity turns this into ordinary χ=M, and additive complement χ_c vanishes. This is an infinite-format geometric proof, not an inference from bounded checker.
residual_risks: Euler localization needs finite-type complex algebraic variety and algebraic torus action, both satisfied; no claim on finer topology.
